findings.summary: Pre-flight aggregation still short-circuits phase-one/keyring validation: if `secure_dependency_path` for the phase-one receipt raises, execution skips validation of `--producer-keyring`, so a run with both paths invalid reports only the phase-one violation and requires another run. This violates the stated one-run aggregation for independent phase-one/keyring inputs.

A malformed report is parsed only after the aggregated pre-flight block. When another pre-flight violation exists (for example an invalid prompt path), `bind_artifacts=False` skips report parsing and the command returns only that other violation; fixing it then reveals the malformed report on a later run. Report validation therefore is not fully aggregated as required.
